propositions: The current adf.py text_to_adf encodes Markdown as literal text without structured ADF marks (headings, lists, code blocks, emphasis), causing rich text to render as raw source on Jira Cloud.

A vendored marklas implementation (pinned to upstream version/sha) must provide markdown_to_adf and adf_to_markdown functions that achieve ≥99.6% idempotent round-trip over a 5,730-body corpus while producing structurally-rich ADF for >56% of bodies.
The adf_to_markdown function must normalize mark ordering (e.g., combined strong+strikethrough) to eliminate oscillation cycles so co-located marks converge in ≤1 pass.
The fit_markdown_to_adf_limit function must measure the markdown_to_adf serialization (not plain text) to correctly bound future Markdown-aware wire encoding.

New Markdown-aware functions are added to adf.py as pure functions without modifying AdfCodec, live send sites, or observable Cloud behavior on merge; the cutover to these functions is deferred to story 3388.
